title: Bookings Administrator
description:
My client is a fast growing service provider based in the Warwick area. Due to an increased workload there is a need for a Bookings Administrator. This will be on an initial 3 month contract that could be extended.

The main purpose of the role is to provide effective administrative support to ensure the efficient operation of the office. The role will involve working closely with office colleagues, while also maintaining regular contact with other members of staff, customers, suppliers and external stakeholders.

Reporting to the Office Manager and providing administrative support to the wider team, the successful candidate will be responsible for:
- Answering incoming telephone calls and acting as the first point of contact for the organisation.
- Responding promptly and professionally to customer and supplier enquiries and queries.
- Taking bookings by telephone and email.
- Placing bookings with external providers and monitoring their delivery to ensure requirements are met.
- Preparing and maintaining all relevant documentation and paperwork.
- Assisting with internal audits and providing administrative support as required.
- Accurately entering and maintaining information within spreadsheets.
- Entering and maintaining data within the finance system.
- Carrying out general office administration, including filing, photocopying and scanning.
- Undertaking any other reasonable administrative duties as required to support the effective operation of the office.

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong customer service skills and a professional approach when dealing with customers and suppliers.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to process data and information accurately.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines.
- The ability to work independently with minimal supervision and demonstrate initiative.
- A positive, flexible and adaptable approach to work.
- The ability to work effectively as part of a team.
- Previous experience using Sage 50 would be desirable but is not essential.

This is an office based role

title: HR Assistant
description:
HR Assistant

We are working exclusively with a well-known, European leading organisation on the lookout for a HR Assistant to join their team in Warwick. This is an incredible opportunity to join a great company within a fantastic team.

This role will be responsible for managing the administration for the whole employee life cycle, for all employees split over two business units. Providing a proactive and efficient HR administrative service that supports the overall objectives of the department. Acting as the point of contact for all first level HR issues, ensuring correct procedures are followed; documented where applicable and excellent service is provided to all stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
- To be the first point of contact for all HR queries - providing guidance and support to managers and/or employees in line with company policies and procedures and statutory provisions
- Maintaining an efficient and effective new starter process from point of offer through to onboarding, ensuring that the set HR procedure is followed and all associated electronic and paper based information is inputted in a timely manner
- Maintain all updates on the HR management systems (SAP; Success Factors and Umantis) and all other internal HR systems)
- Ensuring a strong link is maintained between HR and Payroll and all associated documentation is submitted with accuracy and on time
- Providing a general administrative service for the HR department, including but not limited to:
- Generating letters, contracts and ensuring statutory process adherence
- Updating KPI information and generating ad hoc statistical reporting
- Respond to external and internal information requests
- Supporting projects and completion of HR objectives
- Assisting with the recruitment process, from applicant tracking through to assisting with first level assessments
- Processing invoices & monitoring departmental budgetary spend
- Conducting exit interviews
- General office duties such as the upkeep of personnel records and maintaining the H.R filing and archive system, standards forms and compliance with GDPR
- Provide support with the facilitation of training source and arrange course enrolment, gather information to produce training agreements and maintain records of training undertaken.
- Provide advice and guidance to managers, supporting on first level employee relations issues
- Managing and supporting the recruitment process including administration and first level assessment support
- Undertake projects as and when required in line with the objectives of the role

KEY REQUIREMENTS
- Previous administration experience in a fast-paced commercial business
- Dealing with confidential subject matter
- Experience working with SAP
- Knowledge and ability to offer first line HR advice in relation to current legislation
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders and competing deadlines
- Managed a high level of recruitment activity
- First level HR advice, e.g. performance issues, ER, coaching
- HR Degree (or equivalent HR qualification)
- Confidence to deal with people internally and externally at all levels
- Ability to use own initiative and learn quickly
- Ability to prioritise own work levels

By applying for this position, you authorise Auctoro Recruitment to hold your personal details on file for use in finding you a suitable position. Auctoro Recruitment will never transfer your information to a third party without your prior consent.

title: Property Litigation Paralegal
description:

Client Details

This professional services firm is based in Warwickshire and operates in the legal sector.

Description
- Draft and review legal documents related to property disputes.
- Assist solicitors with case preparation and legal research.
- Communicate with clients, keeping them updated on case progress.
- Manage case files and ensure all documentation is accurately maintained.
- Liaise with external parties such as surveyors and opposing legal teams.
- Monitor and adhere to deadlines for court filings and submissions.
- Provide administrative support to the wider legal team as needed

Profile

A successful Property Litigation Paralegal should have:
- Previous litigation experience is advantageous.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Proactive and professional approach to work.
- Genuine interest in property litigation and contentious matters.
- Strong academic background considered where litigation experience is limited

Job Offer
- Permanent position within the legal sector.
- Additional benefits to be confirmed.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Purchase Ledger Clerk required for a new and exciting opportunity working for a rapidly developing business based in Warwick. You will be working as part of a small friendly team and be responsible for processing up to 500 invoices on a monthly basis from start to finish. Your duties will include matching batching and coding invoices, ensuring PO's have been raised, preparing invoices ready for payment, reconciling supplier statements, processing employee expenses, processing subcontractor payments and assisting with month end.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced purchase ledger clerk looking for a new role or for a financially minded individual looking for their first role in finance who is looking to build their career. You must have excellent interpersonal skills, have strong attention to detail, experience working with Microsoft Excel and ideally be local to Warwick as this is an office based role. My client is offering 25 days annual leave, a modern open plan working environment, a lovely working culture and study support so apply now!

description:

WARWICK TOWN CENTRE
24,454 per annum + bonus of 3% + discretionary profit related bonus

Mon - Thu 8.30- 5.00, Fri 8.30 - 1.00 (37hours)

Well-presented with a proactive can do approach?

Many national and international high level clients visit the offices of this Award winning company - and will rely on you to provide a warm welcome and to ensure meeting rooms and hospitality arrangements run smoothly.

Organised, good at planning ahead and can prioritise.

Team spirited with a positive "Can do" attitude.
Professional and friendly, able to act with discretion and confidentiality.
